description: Search live events with Ticketmaster's Discovery API: concerts, sport, theatre, comedy and family shows across more than 20 countries, from Ticketmaster, Universe, FrontGate and Ticketmaster Resale. Find what is on near a place or in a city, follow an artist's tour dates or a venue's diary, be told when tickets go on sale, and read an event in full: venue, line-up, prices, onsale windows and the link to buy.
